findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：無單一直接客戶占營收 10% 以上，前十大直接與經銷客戶合計 56.7%；採購為 PO 制無最低採購量，主要客戶可能無預警終止、減少訂單、轉向競爭對手或自行開發產品（in-house）。
findings.excerpt: In the fiscal year ended October 3, 2025, no direct customers individually accounted for 10% or more of our revenue and sales to our top 10 direct and distribution customers accounted for an aggregate of 56.7% of our revenue.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子列出客戶可能轉向競爭對手或自行開發產品，屬一般性風險揭露；兩次搜尋未找到 2026 年具體客戶導入第二供應商或 in-house 的報導或協議。
findings.excerpt: it is possible that any of our major customers could terminate their purchasing arrangements with us with little or no warning and without penalty, or significantly reduce or delay the amount of our products that they order, purchase products from our competitors or develop their own products internally.

customer_second_source.note: 未找到 2026 具體第二供應商/自製事件；僅一般性風險揭露。
